title: Resolve callback execution tokens to their bundle team
body:
Closes #75364

### Problem

Execution API tokens for executor callbacks use the callback ID as their subject. The shared team lookup treated every execution subject as a TaskInstance ID, so callback requests were treated as teamless. This could select global Connections or Variables instead of team-scoped values, and caused callback XCom requests to fail team authorization.

### Solution

Resolve execution subjects against both task instances and callbacks. Callback team membership comes from the callback's DAG bundle. Preserve task token and teamless behavior, and reject ambiguous subjects that match both a task instance and callback so a token cannot resolve to a different team. Apply the same identity lookup to XCom authorization.

### Tests

Added coverage for callback, task, teamless, and ambiguous identity lookups; callback Variable team context; and callback XCom access within and across teams.

### Checks

- Ruff format and Ruff check passed.
- Python compile check passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Focused pytest could not complete: pytest setup attempted to download provider dependencies, but DNS access to pypi.org failed. The updated Variable and XCom regression tests remain unverified.

##### Was generative AI tooling used to co-author this PR?

- [X] Yes — OpenAI Codex (GPT-6)

+def get_team_name_for_execution_identity(identity_id, session) -> str | None:
+    """Return the team of a task or callback execution token subject."""
+    rows = session.execute(_team_name_for_execution_identity_stmt(identity_id)).all()
+    return _team_name_from_execution_identity_rows(rows)
+
+
+def _team_name_from_execution_identity_rows(rows) -> str | None:
+    if len(rows) > 1:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=status.HTTP_403_FORBIDDEN,
+            detail="Execution token subject matches multiple workload identities",
+        )
+    return rows[0][0] if rows else None
+
+
+def _team_name_for_execution_identity_stmt(identity_id):
+    """Build a lookup from task or callback IDs to their owning bundle's team."""
+    task_team = (
+        select(Team.name.label("team_name"))
+        .select_from(TaskInstance)
+        .outerjoin(DagModel, DagModel.dag_id == TaskInstance.dag_id)
+        .outerjoin(DagBundleModel, DagBundleModel.name == DagModel.bundle_name)
+        .outerjoin(DagBundleModel.teams)
+        .where(TaskInstance.id == identity_id)
+    )
+    callback_team = (
+        select(Team.name.label("team_name"))
+        .select_from(Callback)
+        .outerjoin(DagBundleModel, DagBundleModel.name == Callback.bundle_name)
+        .outerjoin(DagBundleModel.teams)
+        .where(Callback.id == identity_id)
+    )
+    return task_team.union_all(callback_team).limit(2)
+
